product_flow_readiness.title: 启动进入 Home
product_flow_readiness.exit: Empty or Normal is derived after records resolve

product_flow_readiness.title: Empty Home
product_flow_readiness.exit: Camera / Gallery / Guide / My Catches / Account actions

product_flow_readiness.title: Normal Home
product_flow_readiness.exit: Camera / Gallery / Guide / My Catches / Account / catch details

product_flow_readiness.title: Camera capture
product_flow_readiness.guard: Camera permission and CameraX ready; fallback is offered when unavailable
product_flow_readiness.exit: Normalized image calls onImageReady

product_flow_readiness.title: Gallery select
product_flow_readiness.trigger: Home album CTA or Identify gallery action
product_flow_readiness.exit: Same normalized-image handoff as camera

product_flow_readiness.title: Captured
product_flow_readiness.entry: Identify stores SelectedImage and navigates recognizing
product_flow_readiness.exit: DetectionStarted

product_flow_readiness.title: Detecting
product_flow_readiness.exit: OUTLINE / NO_FISH / TOO_FAR / technical failure

product_flow_readiness.title: Outline
product_flow_readiness.exit: CLASSIFYING or invalid crop failure

product_flow_readiness.title: Classifying
product_flow_readiness.exit: SUCCESS / CONFIRM / UNKNOWN / technical failure

product_flow_readiness.title: High
product_flow_readiness.trigger: Classifier eligible and p1 ≥ 0.45 with no medium tie condition
product_flow_readiness.exit: Edit/select species; Save or Continue Memory; failure remains on Result

product_flow_readiness.title: Medium
product_flow_readiness.guard: Ready prediction; suggestions are not user confirmation
product_flow_readiness.exit: Require explicit species confirmation then continue to dual CTA

product_flow_readiness.title: Low
product_flow_readiness.guard: Species cannot be claimed confirmed; save blocked until manual selection
product_flow_readiness.entry: Result keeps metadata/story as editable draft
product_flow_readiness.exit: LOW_MANUAL selection resumes requested destination; cancel preserves draft and clears pending destination

product_flow_readiness.title: No Fish
product_flow_readiness.exit: Retake or select gallery; no FishRecord

product_flow_readiness.title: Image Quality
product_flow_readiness.trigger: TOO_FAR or ineligible input without failure code
product_flow_readiness.guard: Recognition cannot safely proceed to classifier
product_flow_readiness.exit: Retake/gallery; no FishRecord; reason-specific semantics remain a gap

product_flow_readiness.title: Technical Failure (outside 3+2)
product_flow_readiness.guard: Technical/model/crop failure is not evidence of no fish or poor image
product_flow_readiness.exit: Retry/retake/gallery recovery; never create record

product_flow_readiness.title: Species confirmation
product_flow_readiness.trigger: Medium candidate selection or Low manual picker
product_flow_readiness.guard: Medium/Low require explicit user selection before persistence
product_flow_readiness.entry: Selector returns to same Result screen
product_flow_readiness.exit: User can continue to Save or Continue Memory

product_flow_readiness.title: Save failure recovery
product_flow_readiness.exit: Retry; avoid duplicate record

product_flow_readiness.title: Ordinary Save Catch outcome
product_flow_readiness.entry: Save fields and applicable correction feedback
product_flow_readiness.exit: Navigate Home

product_flow_readiness.title: Continue Memory outcome
product_flow_readiness.entry: Create record first, then open same FishRecordDetail focused at Memory
product_flow_readiness.exit: Detail page A/B model applies

product_flow_readiness.title: FishRecord Detail A side
product_flow_readiness.trigger: Home recent catch / My Catches card / save route
product_flow_readiness.exit: Edit, share, guide, media actions; B flip only when READY

product_flow_readiness.title: Fish Memory B side
product_flow_readiness.trigger: First READY reveal once per record; later manual Flip
product_flow_readiness.guard: READY required for flip; generation success does not consume reveal until presented
product_flow_readiness.entry: Same detail destination, not a distinct Android route
product_flow_readiness.exit: A/B switch; FAILED/NOT_GENERATED keeps A usable; retry state

product_flow_readiness.title: My Catches
product_flow_readiness.trigger: Home catches CTA or Fish Guide species-catches action
product_flow_readiness.guard: Timeline has loading/error/empty/results; route also supports species filter
product_flow_readiness.entry: Home → my_catches; Fish Guide species → my_catches?speciesId
product_flow_readiness.exit: Record → Detail; Capture → Identify; >10/day → day detail

product_flow_readiness.title: Record Date V2
product_flow_readiness.guard: Current Android app has no Record Date route/callback
product_flow_readiness.entry: Frozen month/year art; latest decision documents runtime pending
product_flow_readiness.exit: Date select/month-year movement and computed totals are design target only

product_flow_readiness.title: Fish Guide home
product_flow_readiness.guard: Guide async loading/offline/error state handled by screen
product_flow_readiness.exit: Species selection → species detail

product_flow_readiness.title: Fish species detail / knowledge cards
product_flow_readiness.guard: Species key resolves; offline fallback possible
product_flow_readiness.exit: Capture / catch detail / species-filtered catches

product_flow_readiness.title: My Habitat: Aquarium/Pond/Lake levels
product_flow_readiness.entry: Design Manager habitat view and reference assets
product_flow_readiness.exit: Runtime destination unverified; asset existence is not an app route

product_flow_readiness.title: My / account root
product_flow_readiness.exit: Edit profile / account security / About

product_flow_readiness.title: Guest / Login
product_flow_readiness.trigger: Guest profile, protected routes, or explicit login
product_flow_readiness.exit: Register / login success home / forgot-password ComingSoon

product_flow_readiness.title: Register
product_flow_readiness.exit: Success → home; errors remain; back → login

product_flow_readiness.title: Profile edit
product_flow_readiness.guard: Signed-in session; expired session redirects Login
product_flow_readiness.exit: Save applies profile; back returns

product_flow_readiness.title: Account security and privacy
product_flow_readiness.exit: Policy/agreement; consent setting; export/delete capabilities show Coming Soon

product_flow_readiness.title: User agreement and privacy policy
product_flow_readiness.guard: Opening the document is not itself consent
product_flow_readiness.exit: Back to source page

product_flow_readiness.title: Detail current share action
product_flow_readiness.entry: Build text/plain with fish name and available metadata; Android chooser
product_flow_readiness.exit: User shares or dismisses; no template selection

product_flow_readiness.title: T01/T02 share templates
product_flow_readiness.guard: Time range/template rules need integration contract
product_flow_readiness.entry: Design product model and partial T01/T02 pages
product_flow_readiness.exit: Export/media selection/interruption/failure are unverified
